scope: Failures below are navigation, display or data-shape failures, not current host/runtime tests. Original failed/clipped evidence is preserved where it was captured; no reconstructed successful native envelope is substituted.

items.detail: Initial broad qa runtime filename navigation was clipped; later narrow exact-path lists were used. It is not a complete directory census.
A guessed p212_dependency_query_driver_preparation01/SOURCE_CONTRACT.md text search returned exit 2. The actual trusted-product source contract was read instead.
Initial small-budget Python and Node lock displays were clipped. Complete later original reads of 146698, 67138 and 82433 bytes are preserved separately; clipped records do not certify complete JSON.

The first 97038-byte single-line saved Python outer sample read was clipped. Parsing that displayed response failed with an unexpected W from the warning prefix. Two attempted sed/rg views were also clipped because the archive is a single large line. A later 40000-token read was complete and parsed as archival data. No author source was executed.

Several combined projections of already saved JSON and browser returns exceeded display budgets. Those displays are navigation only; exact stored original read returns and later focused source slices support the actual decisions.

An orchestrator data projection mistakenly called old.node.files.map; the saved object is a mapping. It raised TypeError: old.node.files.map is not a function before the planned browser call. A later object-entry projection corrected navigation; no host tool or new program ran in that failed call.

A sed request for trusted_product_source_delta01/runtime_probe.py returned exit 2 because that name does not exist. Narrow actual filenames located python_runtime_probe.py and node_runtime_probe.js; the former was reread completely.

The first raw Linux v6.8 stat.h fetch returned HTTP 429. The primary GitHub tagged view subsequently supplied the actual Structure/mask text. The failed browser return remains in PRIMARY_SOURCE_READS_NATIVE.json.

Node BigInt Stats does not expose the native returned birthtime mask and libuv can synthesize birthtime from ctime. This is recorded, not treated as a failed host observation. Parent authorized the separate ordinary-trusted Python Structure observer as the source-only alternative.

Manual source reading led to retaining link/name events on failures, distinguishing lexical terminal-symlink lstat from resolved stat, stopping immediately on first error rather than repeating a failed target in pass 2, recording returned masks explicitly, requiring character-device /dev/null, and adding closing control keys. Original draft patch/read evidence remains. These are not independent findings or executed regression tests.
